card.name: Linking words inside warning statements
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as of, the, both, or the start of 'lactic', right before a named drug class or condition in warning text. Also 'agents' after 'systemic antibacterial'.

modes.label: Linking word before drug class
modes.description: Words like 'the' or 'of' after 'use' or 'with', just before a drug or drug class in a warning.
modes.example: has been reported with<< the>> use of nearly all systemic antibacterial agents

modes.label: Inside 'lactic acidosis'
modes.description: The first letter piece of 'lactic' in 'risk of lactic acidosis'.
modes.example: The risk of<< l>>actic acidosis may, therefore, be

modes.label: Class noun after antibacterial
modes.description: The word 'agents' ending a drug class phrase in the diarrhea warning.
modes.example: nearly all systemic antibacterial<< agents>>, including PIVYA, and may
